photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 15:17:50
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 219 s; on-screen clock 04/17/13 15:17:50, wanted 15:17:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-106 15:17' on 2013-04-16 (`as run matrix!B100`), read as 2013-04-16 15:17. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-16 plus one day, 15:17: it was found 169 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (62) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('62, pot 0.4, 0.35, , off', `as run matrix!J100`).
